decisions.reason: As a newly launched core door-handle family with no visible negative feedback, it likely remains above a tolerable aspiration level and is worth retaining while the firm learns about market acceptance.

This mitred handle family fits the firm's architecture-led premium portfolio, and in the absence of clear underperformance a German manufacturer with design and production slack would usually continue it for another year.
A multifunctional door lever aligns well with accessibility and coordinated system-solution ambitions, so management would likely keep it unless stronger evidence of failure emerges.
Although the signal is weaker than for the more prominently presented launches, it is still a close fit with the established handle business and would typically be kept while demand data matures.
Its dedicated presentation and German Design Award indicate performance clearly above aspiration, making withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.
As a finish option that supports premium differentiation and can be deployed across existing ranges with limited extra resource commitment, it would usually be retained absent clear market rejection.
